description: Convert power between watts, kilowatts, horsepower (mechanical and metric), BTU/h and dBm. Enter a value once and see it in every unit instantly.

faqs.q: What is the difference between mechanical and metric horsepower?
faqs.a: Mechanical (imperial) horsepower is 745.69987 W; metric horsepower (PS) is 735.49875 W — about 1.4% less.
dBm is a logarithmic power unit referenced to 1 milliwatt: P(dBm) = 10·log₁₀(P / 1 mW). 0 dBm = 1 mW, 30 dBm = 1 W.

faqs.q: How many watts are in a BTU per hour?
faqs.a: 1 BTU/h = 0.29307107 W. A typical 12,000 BTU/h air conditioner therefore moves about 3.5 kW of heat.
